description: Two big eyes in a wobble of pond water. Corner it and it bursts into spray, then gathers itself back up.
lore: No creature drowned to make the ponds' one. A low wet place got remembered by a great many people and visited by none of them, and the remembering pooled the way water pools, and one morning it had a face. Fight it and it bursts — alarming exactly once — sits a moment as a flat wet patch, and is a blob again before you have decided how you feel about that. Nothing lands. There is nothing in it to land on.

The sorters' first question for any wild thing — what has it lost? — goes nowhere here, which is exactly why [[characters/ef25b1f0|Bettany]] carried her whole list down to the pond and put every question to one aloud, in order, while it wobbled and watched her. It burst once, when a heron came down, and was back before she had finished the next question. Under its page in [[lore/the_chronicle|the Chronicle]] she wrote: stayed to the end of the questions, which is more than most people do. She maintains that this was an observation.

The pond, for what it is worth, has not moved since. Two Turns have been through the low country and left it exactly where her page says it is. [[characters/a6d7323d|Gunnar]] marks it on his maps as the stillest water in the district and, being Gunnar, will not say why he thinks so.
